qAndA.answer: The cotton fields represent the Mississippi Delta, where B.B. King was born and where the blues originated. This connects his music to a history of hardship and resilience within the African American community.
qAndA.question: What is the significance of the image of the cotton fields?

qAndA.answer: Clapton emphasizes the word 'great' with a tone of awe, suggesting that B.B. King's music goes beyond technical skill and has emotional depth, authenticity, and originality.

qAndA.answer: This quote underscores the power of B.B. King's stage presence and the emotional depth he conveyed through his facial expressions and body language, suggesting his music was a visual and visceral experience.
qAndA.question: What is the significance of Carlos Santana saying he can hear B.B. King even with the 'sound off?'

youtube_description: Narrated by Morgan Freeman, B.B. King: The Life of Riley is the untold true American story of an orphan boy from the heart of the Mississippi Delta who rose to music stardom around the world and inspired a generation of fans against all odds. The documentary includes never-before-seen interviews with rock legends including U2's Bono, Eric Clapton, Carlos Santana, Ringo Starr and many others. Experience the inspirational journey of survival for the very first time with Rock and Roll Hall of Famer and 15-time GRAMMY winning artist Riley 'BB' King.
